blacksmith.name: Ladis Washrum
greet: Bring me scrap and coin, and I'll make you something fine.
Mind the sparks. What are we making today?
Steel remembers every hammer blow. Let's give it good ones.
forge: Hah! Finest work this side of the mountain.
Still warm. Try not to lose it.
great: By my beard... I haven't made one like that in years!
That one's going in the song books.
upgrade: Stronger now. Hit things with it.
A few more blows and it sings.
upgrade2: Two steps at once! The metal liked you today.
fail: Bah! The metal fought back. Your scrap's gone, but the piece is safe.
Not today. The forge is moody.
down: Ach... a crack. It's a step weaker now. Sorry, friend.

peddler.name: Pip Wanderwick
greet: Step right up! Everything's one of a kind, and none of it's stolen. Mostly.
Ah, a customer! Have a look, have a look.
Fresh from three kingdoms away. Don't ask which three.
buy: A fine choice! You've got an eye for quality.
Take good care of that one.
haggle_win: Oof, you drive a hard bargain. Fine, fine, a quarter off!
haggle_fail: Hah! Nice try, friend. Prices stay as they are.
haggle_bad: Insulting! For that, prices just went up.

farmer.name: Marta Hayes
greet: Mind the mud, dear. Come to meet the animals?
Every hero needs a friend who bites. Or clucks.
They're well fed and ready for adventure!
buy: Treat them kindly and they'll follow you anywhere.
A fine little one. Give it a good name!
bring: Off you go, then. Bring them back in one piece!
Good choice. They've been itching for a walk.
